recordContract.pcodePolicy: Do not fabricate P-codes. Formal admin records are not production-ready without verified P-codes where the source provides them.

deduplicationPolicy: Never merge solely because names match.
Prefer same verified P-code for formal deduplication.
Same normalized Arabic name in different governorates remains separate.
District and locality with same display name remain separate records at different levels.

arabicSearchNormalization.caution: Do not blindly merge ة and ه. Do not alter canonical display names.
